presentation.label: Experimental monophonic saw machine
presentation.summary: One to seven detuned saw oscillators, with stereo spread and native track processing.
presentation.overview: Monophonic source draft. The exact private RAM package has produced sound on an Octatrack MKII with public base 0.7.13; unassigned Undo passed, but timed audition rollback failed and durable installation remains unqualified.
highlights: Six SRC controls; one instance per Part.
Native AMP and track effects; sequencing and modulation heard in prior RAM trials.
No sub oscillator or chord mode in this reference version.
usage: Use only a separately qualified compatible base and private package; this draft is not available in the public library.
In a backed-up test project choose SUPERSAW on one audio track, open SRC and use TUNE, DETN, MIX, OSC, WIDE and LEVL.
Trigger a note at low monitoring volume, check STOP, then return the track to FLEX before requesting Undo. Do not Keep or reboot with a SuperSAW track until persistence is qualified.

access.location: Audio track > SRC SETUP > SUPERSAW, on a qualified private build only

controls.name: TUNE
controls.doc: Pitch on the native FLEX scale; the centre value is 64.

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: Balance of the centre oscillator and detuned side oscillators.

controls.name: OSC
controls.doc: One to seven oscillators. Stored values 0–6 display as 1–7.

controls.name: WIDE
controls.doc: Stereo spread of the saw oscillators.

controls.name: LEVL
controls.doc: Source output level; zero is silent.

limitations: Exact private package played on public base 0.7.13; unassigned Trial/Undo passed. Timed audition rollback failed, with a later check finding normal mode and empty inventory. Public packaging, SW/1 boot protection and durable lifecycle remain open.
Unlisted source draft, not a public installable release.
One SuperSAW instance per Part, monophonic; OSC is oscillator count, not polyphony.
Prior exact RAM package uses ABI 8; ABI 10 maximum alone does not establish incompatibility or compatibility.
Do not Keep, save a project containing this draft or reboot with it until SW/1 absent-machine validation and persistence are qualified.
Eight-track listening used short samples on the former base; 82.6% was global CPU, not the isolated cost of SuperSAW.
